source:
@@U00064@@
As long as he walks the earth I forbid you nothing.
Striving and straying are a well-known couple.

@@U00066@@
For which much thanks.
I’ve never been fond of the dead.
It’s fresh, plump rosy cheeks I take a liking to.
No, I’ve never favored corpses.
Cat and mouse is more my style.

@@U00068@@
Good, then, I leave it to you.
Divert this spirit from its primal source.
Lure him, if you can lay hold of him,
down your wayward path to perdition.
But have the courtesy, like it or not,
to admit to your shame when you've failed.
A good man, no matter how off course,
always knows the right path from the wrong.

@@U00070@@
Good enough.
And J assure you it won't be long.
I'd say it’s a pretty safe bet.
But promise me, if I succeed,
you'll let me triumph from the bottom of my being.
Ill see him eat dust,
and with a passion, too,
like my distant cousin the celebrated serpent.

@@U00072@@
There, too, you're free to do as you please.
I've never hated the likes of you.
Of all the spirits of negation, rogues like you
are the least of my troubles.
Man's will to action nods off all too easily
and leads him into unproductive repose.
translation:
@@U00064@@
只要他还在世上行走，我就不会禁止你。
奋斗和流浪是众所周知的一对。

@@U00066@@
非常感谢。
我从来不喜欢死人。
我喜欢它清新、丰润、红润的脸颊。
不，我从来不喜欢尸体。
猫和老鼠更符合我的风格。

@@U00068@@
好吧，那我就交给你了。
转移这种精神的原始来源。
如果你能抓住他，引诱他
走上你任性的灭亡之路。
但要有礼貌，不管喜欢与否
当你失败时承认你的耻辱。
一个好男人，无论多么离谱，
总是知道正确的道路和错误的道路。

@@U00070@@
足够好了。
J向你保证这不会太久。
我想说这是一个非常安全的选择。
但答应我 如果我成功的话
你会让我从内心深处获得胜利。
我会看到他吃灰尘，
也带着热情，
就像我的远房表弟著名的蛇一样。

@@U00072@@
在那里，你也可以自由地做你想做的事。
我从来没有讨厌过你这样的人。
在所有的否定之灵中，像你这样的流氓
是我最小的麻烦。
人的行动意志太容易打瞌睡
并引导他进入无效的休息状态。
